description: The rib cage forms a resilient barrel that protects the thoracic organs while expanding and contracting with every breath artists must suggest.

landmarks.name: Manubrium
landmarks.desc: Superior sternum plate where the clavicles lock in and the jugular notch dips.

landmarks.name: Body of sternum
landmarks.desc: Long central shield receiving true ribs and providing a luminous midline plane.

landmarks.name: Xiphoid process
landmarks.desc: Tapered inferior tip that tucks into the epigastric hollow yet guides the abdominal wedge.

landmarks.name: Costal arch
landmarks.desc: Sweeping cartilage rim of ribs seven through ten that frames the solar plexus.

landmarks.name: Angle of rib
landmarks.desc: Posterolateral bend where ribs change direction and catch oblique lighting.

landmarks.name: Upper lateral ribs
landmarks.desc: Sawtooth surfaces of ribs one through nine where serratus anterior interlocks with the obliques.

landmarks.name: Floating ribs
landmarks.desc: Eleventh and twelfth ribs that hover in muscle, hinting at movement and flexibility.
